"import cadquery as cq

L = 90.0          # base plate size along X
W = 60.0          # base plate size along Y
T = 10.0          # base plate thickness along Z (base face at z=0)
BOSS_D = 30.0     # boss diameter
BOSS_H = 20.0     # boss height above plate top (boss top at z=30)
HOLE_D = 8.0      # through-hole diameter
HX = 33.0         # hole center X offsets (+/-)
HY = 18.0         # hole center Y offsets (+/-)

part = (cq.Workplane("XY").rect(L, W).extrude(T)
        .faces(">Z").workplane().circle(BOSS_D / 2.0).extrude(BOSS_H)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .pushPoints([(-HX, -HY), (HX, -HY), (-HX, HY), (HX, HY)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0).cutThruAll())
cq.exporters.export(part.val(), "part.step")"
